rubric.note: Subjective internal editorial ratings with evidence; not an automatic humour metric or an independent live review.

card.title: Power Looks Good
card.instruction: Act fascinated by confident behavior; imitate it closely while resenting how naturally it seems to work.

transfer.action: I copy your commanding pause while presenting {prop}.
transfer.opening: Your pause gets everyone listening without any effort. I'm copying it. {request}
transfer.response: How long did you hold that pause? You make this look annoyingly easy. {counter}
transfer.closing: I'd like your attention. Was that your exact tone? Four words, and I still have to practise being you.

originalTransfer.action: I copy your commanding pause while presenting {prop}.
originalTransfer.opening: Interesting way to hold the room. Watch mine. {request}
originalTransfer.response: I think my version carries more weight. {counter}
originalTransfer.closing: And gave the method an opportunity to serve stronger leadership.

beats.text: You got us this table with one raised eyebrow. Show me. Must be nice having that face.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I raised the left one. But please just ask for the bill; I'm late.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Left. Like this? You barely moved yours.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You got a table in a second. I'm getting a cramp asking for paper.

bindings.scope: Fresh binding-only review of an explicit transfer-body amendment. Read the exact card, both original and accepted candidate single dialogues, and every original/proposed transfer field. Are the proposed fields faithful to the exact mechanism and their described source material? Identify real residual contradictions or unsupported details. Seed hashes still describe the historical originals; validated integration will bind the accepted dialogue only after your compatibility assessment. A compiled transfer is not an individually reviewed pair. Do not score single or pair dialogue; records must be empty. No writer scores or improvement claims are supplied.
